items.title: Local finiteness of the support of a coherent module and finiteness of the length at a generic point
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma records three facts about the support of a coherent module: its irreducible components are locally finite, the length of the stalk at the generic point of a component is finite, and a point where the dimension function attains the maximal value on the support is a generic point of a component (statement lines 1701-1720, tag 02QH-adjacent). The first and third are deduced from the corresponding statements for a reduced closed subscheme, and the second requires the observation that the nearby stalks vanish so that the stalk is supported at the closed point of a local ring, hence of finite length. That vanishing argument is the substance, so the claim is H2.
